annotations.title: Buy an appraisal: human card checkout ($5)

description: RAIL: HUMAN CARD. Buy a fresh appraisal of one domain, computed on this server, for $5, paid by a person at a hosted Square checkout page. Use it when appraise_domain answered notAppraised and the user wants the figure returned to you rather than opened in their browser. Returns checkoutUrl (a Square payment page for the user: no account, no sign-in), orderId and orderToken. Give checkoutUrl to the user; after they pay, call appraisal_order_status with orderId and orderToken to collect the appraisal. Keep orderToken: it is shown once and is the only proof of purchase. A paid order that cannot be delivered is refunded in full. Not this rail when no person can pay: buy_appraisal_agent_card charges an operator-enrolled card unattended for the same $5; purchase_appraisal draws $0.03 from an operator-funded prepaid balance for the same fresh appraisal (https://audit.domains/machine-account).
